messages:
Maya Sales: Priya from NovaCorp here. They want their egress to appear from our Dedicated endpoint but must map to a fixed set of IPs on their firewall. Can they bring their static NAT IPs to you?

Noah NetEng: Short answer: we can't host customer-owned public IPs on our shared Dedicated pools. We can allocate static outbound IPs from our pool for the duration of the POC, or set up a Private deployment/VPC connection so egress originates from their VPC.

Priya (NovaCorp): If you provide static outbound IPs, will they rotate during the day? Our SOC disallows mid-window rotation.

Ravi SE: For POCs we reserve a small set of stable outbound IPs (no rotation) for the window you request. For production we recommend Private + site-to-site VPN or Dedicated reserved pools with guaranteed IP stability as a paid option.

Noah NetEng: Also, if you need strict mutual auth, we can enable mTLS for the egress path, but that requires additional setup and an enterprise contract.

Priya (NovaCorp): What's the minimum window and lead time? Our change board needs documentation.

Maya Sales: Typical lead time 48 business hours from request + signed POC agreement. Minimum window is 24 hours, common is 72 hours. We'll provide exact CIDRs and a start/end timestamp.

Priya (NovaCorp): Can you provide a sample allowlist doc to give to our infra team? Also need curl example for smoke test.

Ravi SE: Creating sample now. We'll include CIDRs, expected ports, and curl.

Ravi SE: Sample allowlist snippet:
```
Allow: 52.22.101.11/32
Allow: 52.22.101.12/32
Protocol: TCP 443 (outbound to our endpoint)
Window: 2026-04-05T08:00Z -> 2026-04-08T08:00Z
Notes: Only needed for POC traffic; these IPs are specific to the reserved pool for NovaCorp POC
```

Ravi SE: Curl smoke test (use poc key we send):
```
curl -v -X POST https://dedicated.poc.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-novacorp-abc" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

Noah NetEng: Firewall rule: allow outbound TLS to dedicated.poc.redwood.ai on 443 from app subnet. If customer blocks by SNI, recommend IP allowlist instead of hostname.

Priya (NovaCorp): Any extra fees for the static IP reservation during POC?

Maya Sales: There is a small infra reservation fee for static outbound IPs on Dedicated pools; we'll reflect it as an optional line on the POC quote. No token price changes for the test.

Priya (NovaCorp): Great. Could you open a support ticket with the exact CIDRs and the quote line so I can attach to our change request?

ticket-bot: Support ticket #800501 opened by @Maya Sales. Assigned to eng-net. ETA: 1 business day.

Ravi SE: Ticket updated with allowlist snippet, curl test, and the optional IP reservation fee. I'll also paste the public key thumbprint if you want mTLS later.

Priya (NovaCorp): Thanks — forwarding to our SOC. One last ask: if we outgrow the POC, how fast is migration to Private or VPN?

Noah NetEng: Migration path is straightforward: after contract we provision a private endpoint and coordinate VPN or VPC peering. Typical timeline 2-3 weeks depending on paperwork and network approvals.

Maya Sales: Perfect. I'll follow up with the quote and next steps. :white_check_mark:
